fields.description: Issue includes political commentary on Dade County and Miami Beach elections and local governance, including discussion of milk pricing and taxation, water-rate increases, and criticism of Florida Power & Light and municipal utility arrangements. Reports cover employment trends from the Florida Employment Service, traffic-safety warnings about unsafe cars and hot-rod driving, and a discussion of railroad-crossing safety following a fatal crash. Additional content includes civic and community notices (Jewish War Veterans memorial services; Children's Home Society of Florida fundraising), national political/labor commentary on Taft-Hartley lobbying, and extensive entertainment/nightlife listings and advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach venues.
